messages:
greta (Finance Ops): flagging an oddity on AWS MP invoice EL-2026-3301. Looks like EdgeLane's staging "pilot" pricing (50% off) mistakenly applied to three production accounts for Apr. Net underbilling ~ $3,675. Need quick triage and approval for provisional adjustment.
nate (Revenue Ops): ugh. Pilot leaks happen when partner toggles pricebook IDs. Do we have the partner export?
greta (Finance Ops): uploaded CSV: /finance/marketplace/inbound/EL-2026-3301.csv. snippet: 
```
account_id,account_name,pricebook_id,unit_count,unit_price
el-prod-001,AcmeX,edge-pilot-50pct,120,0.50
el-prod-002,DataNest,edge-pilot-50pct,80,0.50
el-prod-003,CoreApps,edge-pilot-50pct,200,0.50
```
lucas (Billing): our pricebook mapping expected edge-prod-std (unit_price 1.00). Looks like partner used pricebook id edge-pilot-50pct for prod accounts. Ingestion accepted rows without validating pricebook ownership.
audit-bot: Ingestion EL-2026-3301 processed 2026-07-08T14:05Z. Alerts: pricebook_id mismatch detected for 3 rows (pilot tag seen in production accounts). Action: FLAGGED_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW.
dina (Partner Success): pinged EdgeLane rep: "Can you confirm whether EL-2026-3301 intentionally applied pilot pricing to these accounts or if this was an export/pricebook routing error? Please provide corrected export and any credit note."
michael (Finance Manager): roughly how much is exposure and what's ask?
greta (Finance Ops): Estimate underbill = (expected price 1.00 - billed 0.50) * unit_counts = (120+80+200) * 0.50 = 400 * 0.50 = $200. Wait math check... re-calc: unit counts sum = 400, price delta = $0.50, amount = $200. Sorry earlier I included discounts on addons, full exposure is $200. There is also downstream FX rounding + tax estimate making gross impact ~$260.
nate (Revenue Ops): thanks for correction. That's below the $2.5k approval threshold. We can authorize an automated credit memo if partner confirms. Protocol: await partner confirmation and amended CSV, but we can queue provisional memo with tag "marketplace-pilot-leak-provisional".
\ldots lucas (Billing): queueing provisional AR credit memo draft and hold settlement until partner responds. Draft saved: /finance/marketplace/credits/EL-2026-3301-provisional.pdf. GL: 5044.
dina (Partner Success): rep replied: "We mistakenly promoted a pilot pricebook to prod for one export; regenerating CSV and issuing credit note. Corrected export ETA 24h." Sent amended CSV to /finance/marketplace/corrections/EL-2026-3301-amended.csv when received.
audit-bot: Received amended CSV at 2026-07-09T09:20Z. Diffs: pilot rows replaced with edge-prod-std. No other changes.
michael (Finance Manager): approve provisional credit release. No manager escalation needed due to amount under threshold. Please include note: "pending partner amended export EL-2026-3301".
greta (Finance Ops): approved and posted provisional credit in AR system, memo number CM-EL-3301-1. Will ingest partner credit note when attached and reverse provisional if partner posts adjustment otherwise keep memo. Closing this thread once amended CSV and partner credit note attached to ticket.
dina (Partner Success): attaching partner credit note to ticket now. :white_check_mark:
greta (Finance Ops): final docs saved: /finance/marketplace/credits/EL-2026-3301-creditnote.pdf. Marking resolved.
